seoTitle: The Rooftop Venue | Cococabana Downtown Oceanside
seoDescription: Tour Cococabana's rooftop venue in Downtown Oceanside — open-air bar, lounge seating, and ocean views for drinks, brunch, and private events.
heroTitle: The Rooftop Venue in Downtown Oceanside
heroText: A rooftop setting built for drinks, dining, celebrations, and coastal nights in Oceanside.

heroImage.alt: Aerial view of Coco Cabana rooftop bar — COCOCABANA sign on The Brick Hotel, Downtown Oceanside

sections.title: The Rooftop
sections.text: Perched above The Brick Hotel at 408 Pier View Way, the rooftop is a full open-air experience — Coastal-inspired cocktails, a complete bar program, and views that stretch past the palm canopy all the way to the Pacific.
sections.imageAlt: Coco Cabana rooftop lounge — rattan pendants, tile wall, city views

sections.title: Open Air Seating
sections.text: An unobstructed views of the Oceanside skyline. Be sure to catch the early day vibes and stay for the sunsets
sections.imageAlt: Coco Cabana lounge seating — pink daybeds, geometric tile wall, Oceanside skyline

sections.title: Sunsets
sections.text: Four stories up, the views stretch past the rooftops and palm canopy all the way to the Pacific. Sunsets here are something else entirely — settle in before golden hour and watch the sky change over the water.
sections.imageAlt: Sunset viewed from Coco Cabana rooftop — palms silhouetted against orange sky

sections.title:
Live Music
& Events
sections.text: Live DJ sets every Friday and Saturday night. The rooftop transforms after dark — cocktails, open air, and the Oceanside skyline as your backdrop. Along with occasional big special live events in our ally.
sections.imageAlt: DJ set at Coco Cabana rooftop with crowd
